specs.title: Kabyle Collation Specification
specs.summary: Alphabetical ordering and collation rules for Kabyle (Taqbaylit): 33-letter sequence with Ɛ placed after A and Ɣ after Q, base-letter-then-modified-letter rule, geminate handling, loanword letter positions (O/P/V), and ready-to-use ICU/CLDR and glibc kab_DZ implementation rules.

specs.title: Kabyle Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) Specification
specs.summary: Specification for a modular, low-resource grammatical error correction (GEC) system for Kabyle (Taqbaylit). Covers nominal state EL/EA, clitic segmentation and ordering, negation and ara disambiguation, orthographic normalization, lexical and dialectal variation, annotation compatible with morphological tokenization and UD/CoNLL-U, synthetic and human-validated training data, hybrid rule-based and statistical modeling, evaluation protocols, abstention, and anti-hallucination safeguards.

specs.title: Dallet–Kabyle Canonical Lexicon Specification
specs.summary: Canonical data model for transforming Jean-Marie Dallet's digitized Kabyle-French dictionary into a traceable, interoperable lexical resource.

specs.title: Taqbaylit-ToBI: Prosodic and Intonation Specification
specs.summary: Autosegmental-Metrical (AM/ToBI) prosodic framework for Kabyle (Taqbaylit): Intonation Units (UI) demarcation, boundary tones (L-L%, L-H%, H-H%), focus-driven pitch excursion (L+H* with post-focal compression in clefts), phrasal head prominence, 5-level break index hierarchy (0 to 4) strictly modeling clitic cohesion and genitive construct state (addad amaruz), and acoustic duration ratios (geminates ×1.8–2.3, pre-pausal lengthening) for neural TTS (FastSpeech 2, VITS) and ASR alignment.

specs.title: Kabyle Nominal State Opposition (Addad Ilelli vs Addad Amaruz)
specs.summary: Deterministic morphophonological mutation tables (masculine and feminine) and a binary syntactic trigger matrix for the Free State (Addad Ilelli) vs Construct State (Addad Amaruz) alternation, resolving the post-verbal subject / direct object ambiguity and the 'd' copula-vs-coordinator homograph. Documents a closed, non-derivable lexicalized class of invariable ta- feminines (taddart, tafat, tasa, tadla, tadimt, tasga; Naït-Zerrad 2001) pending corpus validation, plus a CI/CD minimal-pair test suite.

specs.title: Kabyle Pronouns and Clitics
specs.summary: Empirically-validated inventory, ordering, and allomorphy rules for Kabyle pronominal clitics: object (direct/indirect), possessive, directional (ventif/andatif), demonstrative, and reflexive forms. Documents strict clitic ordering [V/Part + IO + DO + DIR], proclisis triggers (ad, ur, i, ara, la, mi, ay), phonologically conditioned allomorphs (-is/-s, -d/-id, -n/-in, aɣ/ɣ, kent/went), and reflexive nouns (iman/yiman) with possessive suffixes. Validated against 756 774 sentences from the Tatoeba Kabyle cleaned corpus and cross-checked with community affix inventories.

specs.title: Kabyle Braille Transcription
specs.summary: Braille transcription specification for Kabyle (Taqbaylit): CBFU-based grade-1 mapping, two extension modes (indicator and dedicated) for 11 berber-specific characters, Unicode Braille / BRF / Liblouis output formats, and pre-normalization pipeline integration with the kabyle orthography spec.

specs.title: Kabyle Lemmatization Specification
specs.summary: Rules for Kabyle (Taqbaylit) lemmatization in an NLP pipeline: citation forms by POS, apophony normalization, broken plural tables, state-of-annexion remapping, negative apophony, and JSON output schema with status/confidence tracking. Depends on kabyle-conjugations-specs, kabyle-orthography-specs, kabyle-hunspell-dictionary-spec, and kabyle-negation-spec.

specs.title: Kabyle negation specification
specs.summary: Formalization of Kabyle verbal negation: the discontinuous structure ur … ara, negative apophony modeling, UD polarity traits, and lemmatization rules for negative particles. Amorce - most detailed rules remain open for native-speaker validation.

specs.title: Kabyle Hunspell Dictionary Architecture
specs.summary: Structure, metadata schema, and build pipeline for the Kabyle Hunspell dictionary (kab.dic + kab.aff). Documents the po:/st:/is: tag system, flag inventory, known anomalies, and migration path toward a generated, modular affix architecture inspired by Catalan and Hungarian dictionaries.

specs.title: Kabyle color terms
specs.summary: Canonical color terms for Taqbaylit (Kabyle), their gender/number/state inflections, the constructions used to attach them to nouns, and attested variants that implementers must declare rather than silently mix.

specs.title: Kabyle Latin Orthography & Character Normalization
specs.summary: Canonical 33-letter inventory with verified Unicode codepoints, false-friend rejection rules, and quality gates for Kabyle text corpora and AI training pipelines.

specs.title: Kabyle Keyboard Layout Specification
specs.summary: Keyboard layout specification for Kabyle (Taqbaylit): INALCO 1996 character inventory, dead-key input method (KIM), frequency analysis, and OS-specific implementation profiles (AZERTY, QWERTY, Bepo, ErgoL).

specs.title: Expressing time in Kabyle (Taqbaylit)
specs.summary: Grammar of the Kabyle time-telling system (particle D, u/ghir, dialectal variants) with a synonym table for date/time parsers.

specs.title: Kabyle verb conjugator specification
specs.summary: Algorithmic blueprint for generating Kabyle verb paradigms across aspects and morphological groups, after Bouamara's model.

specs.title: Kabyle grapheme-to-phoneme (orthography2ipa)
specs.summary: Full G2P spec for Kabyle: 34-letter Latin inventory, spirantization and allophony rules, for TTS/ASR systems.

specs.title: Kabyle morphological tokenizer
specs.summary: Layered, rule-based tokenizer architecture for Kabyle verb forms, segmenting subject affixes, pronominal clitics, and derivational prefixes.

specs.title: Kabyle Universal Dependencies (UD)
specs.summary: UD annotation framework for Kabyle syntax: VSO order, pro-drop, clitic doubling, copula, and construct state, extending the UD_Kabyle-ADPT treebank.

reports.title: Rapport d'analyse du corpus Tatoeba Kabyle
reports.summary: MaskLID + GlotLID + DistilBERT + Hunspell pipeline v3. 789 712 phrases analysees ; 756 774 pures (95,8 %), 0,24 % code-switching, 3,66 % contamination orthographique, 85,1 % couverture Hunspell. Dashboard + CoNLL-U exports.
